clue.text: Went circuitously to ancient city delving inside document

parts.note: a deed is a legal document

explanation.walkthrough: Ur, in ancient Mesopotamia, is the crossword's favourite old city.

clue.text: Couple audibly attack venomous creature

clue.text: Bike space found in building

definitions.meaning: a ... bike is a four-wheeled motorbike, shortened to its first word
a quadrangle, an open courtyard enclosed by a college's buildings

clue.text: One serves joint outside — a centre piece of Sundays

parts.note: a mitre is a carpentry joint cut at an angle

explanation.definitionFit: A head waiter, from French maître d'hôtel, oversees service in a restaurant dining room.

clue.text: Air-conditioning's needed in an 'atchback? It can stifle you

parts.note: a Honda hatchback with its H dropped, as the apostrophe shows
AC is the abbreviation for air-conditioning

explanation.definitionFit: This great South American snake kills its prey by constriction, squeezing until breathing stops.

clue.text: Swerve periodically in blue environment, and hit the roof

environment names the surroundings, the word for blue, around the picked letters

indicators.note: periodically picks every other letter, the second, fourth and sixth

explanation.walkthrough: 'periodically' takes every second letter of Swerve; 'in ... environment' sets them within the word for blue.

clue.text: Entertainer around back of stage bringing over light for illusion

indicators.note: the entertainer's letters go around the next piece

clue.text: European somewhere in NY avoiding unknown Scot

clue.text: Newsman amid spring depression took a hike

clue.text: Current counterfeit clothes close to Leicester Square

parts.note: beer is booze

by as in multiplication, three by four, is the times sign x

split as no D, E: with no D or E marks awarded, presumably only the higher grades were given

clue.text: Dead, lying in state, heading for burial quickly perhaps

clue.text: Scottish town forcibly hit by alien mutant, twisting tail

clue.text: Totally captivated by the German duke, had a flirt
